svg.title: Transfer functions of a cell
svg.desc: Cell radius against memory, memory-limit ring against usage, membrane wobble against pressure and CPU arc against quota use.
svg.text: (b) limit ring: r sqrt(1 / used), clamped 1.04 to 1.6
pressure p (% of time stalled, avg10)
(d) CPU arc: min(cpu / quota, 1) of a turn
no quota: share of one core
